title: The Grey Quarter Where Clarity Was Born

features.name: the honest corner
features.desc-on-touch: Where someone stood and did not soften the thing they saw. The light here casts no shadows, and clarity arrived.

features.name: the unkindness archive
features.desc-on-touch: Where you find the records of what the country refused to comfort. The clarity is harsh, but it is true.

features.name: the speaking ground
features.desc-on-touch: Grey stones worn smooth by ungentle words that needed to be said. The country learned its own voice here.

features.name: the refusal
features.desc-on-touch: A marker where comfort was refused and clarity was born instead. The boundary between what the country could not be and what it chose to become.

features.name: the grey light
features.desc-on-touch: Neither dawn nor dusk: a light that shows all edges without flattery. Here unkindness learned to speak its own true name.

inscription: unkindness is the country speaking to itself without pretense; clarity is what arrives when kindness stops lying

file.name: Grey_Quarter_Testimony_Unedited.txt
file.note: Records of what was said here without modification. The country naming itself for the first time, harsh and awake.

reverie.title: REVERIE — standing in the grey quarter where she named it
narr: you stand where she stopped, looking at the same road.
"unkindness isn't the problem," she said that day.
"it's pretending we're kind when we're not. the
country refuses to lie here. that's the clarity."
you understand then: this place is where truth lives
not because it's gentle, but because it's honest.

exits.label: back eastward toward the threshold where names learned themselves
northward where clarity teaches others to speak
southward toward the archives that keep hard truths
